subject: Quick thought on the Breeze Dental site & local booking
body: Hi Breeze Dental team, I've always admired how your three Austin locations reimagine the patient experience—especially replacing traditional waiting rooms with retail wellness spaces and offering tech-forward treatments like Airflow cleanings. While browsing your current site, I noticed that deep service pages occasionally deal with content layouts that can disrupt the mobile user flow, and your local schema could be optimized further across your spots. Because I enjoy building fast, clean interfaces for local health providers, I put together a live prototype for Breeze Dental using a modern bento-grid layout, built-in click-to-text scheduling, and explicit local markup for all three Austin spots. Feel free to check out the live preview here: https://nayom-biz-0x8644b4df8ca136ad-0xb8adae0e500a137-iqmtvgdg0.vercel.app. If you'd like to use this design or have me tweak anything, I'd be happy to send over the project files or chat for 5 minutes. No worries at all if you're happy with your current setup!
key_improvements: Streamlined mobile user flow and optimized deep service page layouts
Enhanced local schema markup for all three physical Austin locations
Added prominent click-to-text scheduling functionality alongside traditional calls
